annotations:
  artifacthub.io/changes: |-
    - kind: added
      description: "Add value .service.enabled to enable the creation of the Kubernetes service."
    - kind: added
      description: "Add value replicaCount to set the number of external-dns replicas (bounded to 0 or 1, since external-dns does not support leader election)."
    - kind: added
      description: "Add crd as a valid registry value and grant the matching RBAC on dnsrecords for the CRD registry."
    - kind: added
      description: "Add value hostAliases to inject entries into the Pod's /etc/hosts, for reaching a provider or webhook by a hostname that cluster DNS cannot resolve."
    - kind: changed
      description: "Breaking: policy no longer defaults to upsert-only and is now required. You must set policy explicitly to one of create-only, sync, or upsert-only."
    - kind: changed
      description: "Update ExternalDNS OCI image version to v0.22.0."
    - kind: fixed
      description: "RBAC compliance checkbox for dnsendpoints/status #6442 @vflaux."
